sweep_closed: results/decisions.md, 2026-10-10: luna's sweep closed (PR #55), with its correction of 2026-10-10 (one §13 re-run)

model_check.model: §9.1 confirmatory GLM (statsmodels), W-0 x R: the logit-scale Δ_H1
model_check.basis: a Firth-penalized fit of the §9.1 GLM (rule 'firth')

literal.basis: the sign of the logit-scale Δ_H1's limit, from the cells without outcome variation (rule 'literal'; an undefined sign does not agree)

probability-scale.basis: not applicable: an H1 cell has no outcome variation, so the probability-scale sign is read (rule 'probability-scale')

w_n_0_alongside.note: W-n-0 against F-0: the notes-rescue condition, reported alongside H1, not tested (§3 H1)

h1_lookups.rule: F-0 looked nothing up, so the ratio is undefined: met iff the lower bound of the 90% CI of the difference (W-0 - F-0) is above 0

model_check.powersim_model: power_sim's: template fixed effects + derived term + arm (emulation)

literal.verdict: inconclusive: the Holm test rejects, but the model check does not agree

H3.verdict: inconclusive: the Holm test rejects, but the model check does not agree

glm_9_1.note: statsmodels gives no finite cluster-robust SE (for example under quasi-separation)

glm_9_1_with_w_n_0.note: statsmodels gives no finite cluster-robust SE (for example under quasi-separation)

glm_h3.note: fewer than 2 templates with outcome variation: no fit

glm_h3_powersim.model: power_sim's: template fixed effects + derived term + arm (emulation)
